editorial:
Imagine getting the wrong phone number for the girl of your dreams and then spending your whole semester trying to track her down. That is exactly what happens to our main guy, a goofy musician who is totally head-over-heels for a girl he barely knows. He ends up teaming up with a super smart psychology student who thinks his plan is crazy, but she helps him anyway. The vibe is light, sunny, and full of that chaotic college energy. You will love how their bickering turns into something more as they accidentally start a massive campus-wide search that gets everyone involved. It feels like a warm hug of a movie that does not take itself too seriously.

The acting is great because the chemistry between the two leads feels real and not forced. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though a few of the jokes are a bit predictable. If you are in the mood for something sweet and funny, you should definitely give this a go. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the bright campus colors, or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. It is the kind of film that makes you want to call up an old friend.
endingExplained: After a wild chase across campus, the musician finally finds the real Emily, but he realizes he does not actually have anything in common with her. The big twist is that he fell in love with the psychology student while searching for someone else. He tells her this during a big concert, and they decide to be together. It ends with them laughing about the wrong number while the whole school cheers them on.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute rom-coms and college stories.
